source_snapshot.items: PLDM Firmware Update Support via BMC web when boot into OS
source_snapshot.procedure: Boot the SUT into OS, log into BMC Web GPU Management > Firmware, select the approved image and explicitly Start update.
source_snapshot.criteria: The firmware flash completes successfully without issue.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL recognizes a user-provided image, manual UI and optional Redfish help but lacks signed-target, rollback, uninterrupted-power and explicit-start controls.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED with CRITICAL risk; validate signed image/target, drain workloads, require operator Start, stable power/OOB, full progress/audit and post-flash inventory/health.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly marks the operation state-changing but treats recovery and target validation too generically.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds image manifest/checksum, component compatibility, current/target baseline, backup/rollback, UI-versus-Redfish ownership, interruption prohibitions and post-reboot verification.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row170 independently exercises standby/BMC-on update; its power-state evidence cannot replace the OS-booted variant.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Preserves the OS-active power-state condition and operator-owned Web action rather than silently converting it to an API update.

original_test_intent: Prove the platform supports a controlled PLDM GPU firmware update from BMC Web while the host is in the specified booted-OS state, ending at the exact approved active version with all devices healthy.
original_method: Authenticate/verify the signed target image and current state, drain workloads, have the authorized operator select and start the UI update, monitor uninterrupted progress/power/audit, apply only vendor-required reboot and verify active inventory, GPU/driver/OS/BMC health and rollback readiness.
manual_activity: The authorized operator selects the image and confirms Start; firmware/platform engineers supervise recovery and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
required_inputs: Signed PLDM image/version/manifest/checksum and exact component target
BMC UI/PLDM compatibility and release notes
Current firmware inventory and rollback/backup image
Approved OS boot state, workload drain and vendor reboot/activation policy
Stable power/network, OOB/console, operator and protected evidence plan
safety_requirements: Drain GPU workloads and confirm power/network/OOB recovery
Require explicit human confirmation at Start update
Do not interrupt, close session, reboot/power-cycle or retry during flash
After completion verify exact active version and full platform health before any further mutation
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre-state and validate the supplied image metadata
Assist only within the approved BMC UI or expressly equivalent Redfish workflow
Monitor progress/power/audit and collect post-state evidence
Do not choose image/target, click Start autonomously, retry or issue DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supervise operator, power/OOB and fault recovery
Review flash/post-health evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Optional Redfish assistance is not equivalent unless explicitly approved; the source owns a manual UI selection/Start action with OS booted.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the authorized BMC GPU Firmware UI with verified image and explicit operator Start, or only an approved documented equivalent, while preserving uninterrupted progress and post-flash evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Booted-OS condition, BMC Web path, image selection, Start update and source 5/5 timing are retained; actual duration remains vendor-governed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the flash as a signed change transaction linking pre-inventory/image hash/target, operator UI audit, progress/power continuity, activation result, post-version/health and rollback readiness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing safety/traceability contract without changing the BMC-Web update path.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Standby/off-host update remains a separate next-row variant.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A five-minute source estimate may not reflect firmware upload/activation time and must not drive premature interruption.

project_override_considerations: Redfish may substitute for Web UI only through explicit project equivalence; the operator confirmation, booted-OS condition and post-active version/health coverage must remain.
expected_evidence: Critical approval, signed image manifest/hash and exact target
BMC/UI/PLDM/OS/current firmware baseline and workload-drain proof
UI navigation/selected image plus operator Start and audit timestamps
Complete update progress/result with stable power/network/OOB/SEL
Vendor activation/reboot and exact active target version
GPU/driver/boot/OS/BMC health, rollback readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and literal first step consistently require booted OS before the BMC-Web flash; missing image/recovery details are supplyable execution prerequisites.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Signed image and governed flash/recovery inputs can be supplied; static review is complete without attempting firmware mutation.

review_improvement: Transforms a five-step UI flash outline into a signed, target-specific, uninterrupted and recoverable firmware transaction with exact post-active health proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Web UI success message can precede activation or refer to the wrong component. Firmware evidence must connect image hash and selected target to the active post-update inventory after the vendor activation step. The OS-booted condition also creates workload/driver interactions that differ from standby, so it remains an independent variant and must be drained/observed rather than merged.
